entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This first application under Section 482 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita/438 of the Cr.P.C. has been filed on behalf of the applicant for grant of anticipatory bail.

2. Applicant is apprehending his arrest in connection with FIR/Crime No.RC2182023A0004 registered at Police Station CBI, New Delhi for the offence punishable under Sections 120-B read with Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471 of IPC and Sections 7, 12 and 13(2) read with Section 13(1)(a)
of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that main allegation is against co-accused Prafull Sethia, who was Zonal Head of Uco Bank and he was instrumental in extension of loan on the basis of forged Warehouse receipts.
Learned counsel for the applicant further submits that allegation against him is that in his account Rs.58,50,000/- were credited.

It is also NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:37287 2 MCRC-32774-2025 urged that applicant has co-operated with Investigating Agency during investigation.

It is also urged that he was issued notice under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C and in pursuant to aforesaid notice, applicant appeared before the Investigating Agency on the dates fixed by the Investigating Officer.

In the instant case, after investigation,
charge-sheet has been filed.

1 4 .

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant also submits that learned trial Court has issued non-bailable warrant against present applicant.

With respect to above submissions, learned counsel for the applicant has referred and relied upon Musheer Alam Vs. The State of Uttar Pradesh & Anr. in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.18081 of 2024 dated 17.01.2025 and Mahdoom Bava Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation 2023 SCC OnLine SC 299.

entities.text: Musheer Alam Vs. The State of Uttar Pradesh & Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.18081 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

entities.text: Mahdoom Bava Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation 2023 SCC OnLine SC 299
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant further submits that case of present applicant is identical to that of co-accused Prafull Sethia, who has been released on bail by co-ordinate Bench of this Court.
On above grounds, it is urged that applicant be granted the benefit of anticipatory bail.
5. Learned counsel for the respondent/CBI has opposed the application and submits that no case for grant of anticipatory bail is made out.

However, the counsel does not dispute that the applicant appeared before CBI upon receiving of notice under Section 41-A of Cr.P.C.
6.
Heard.
Perused record of the case.

7. Having regard to factual matrix of the case as well as the fact that similarly situated co-accused Prafull Sethia has been released on anticipatory bail by co-ordinate Bench of this Court by order dated 25.04.2025 passed in M.Cr.C.No.9529 of 2025 and principles laid down in Musheer Alam (Supra) NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:37287 3 MCRC-32774-2025 and Mahdoom Bava (Supra), I deem it proper to release the applicant on anticipatory bail.

8. It is directed that in the event of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail on his executing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand Only) with solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer/Investigating Authority.

9 . The applicant shall further abide by other conditions enumerated under Section 482(2) of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 and shall cooperate in the investigation otherwise this bail order shall automatically stand cancelled.
10. Certified copy as per rules.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE vai Uma Shankar Dharmik vs Central Bureau Of Investigation on 8 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127478274/
